name: Linguistics Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Linguistics (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Cunning Linguist (Ex)

Your expert study of syntax and phonology allows you to break down language barriers quickly to temporarily acquire new languages. You may gain temporary spoken competence with an unknown language after one minute of speaking with someone who knows it, provided you succeeds at a DC 20 Linguistics check. You can even learn secret languages in this way; however, the person you’re speaking with must legitimately be attempting to converse with you in that language. You do not automatically gain the ability to read this new language, but you do gain a +2 bonus to Linguistics checks made to decipher writings made in that language. You may have as many temporary languages at any given time as your Intelligence bonus. You can choose to learn one of your current temporary languages as a permanent language any time you increases your Linguistics score, even if that language would normally require extra research due to its rarity. At any time, you can choose to lose knowledge of one of your temporary languages in order to learn a different one.

Associated Technique
Kinesics Technique (Ex)

Any time you miss on an attack roll against the opponent you have studied with this technique, you gain a +1 insight bonus on your next attack roll against that opponent. This insight bonus increases by 1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level. This bonus does not stack with repeated misses.

Advanced Study Abilities
Arcane Linguist (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Cunning Linguist study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You can identify and decipher all arcane scrolls using Linguistics instead of Spellcraft, and you don’t need to cast read magic in order to decipher such scrolls. You can use the Linguistics skill instead of the Use Magic skill in order to activate a scroll of any kind (arcane or otherwise).

Body Language (Ex, Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Cunning Linguist study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Sense Motive becomes a class skill for you, and you can use inspiration with this skill for free. When you attain 4 ranks in Linguistics, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to use cultural adaptation as a spell-like ability. At 7 ranks, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to use psychic reading as a spell-like ability.

Master Orator (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Cunning Linguist study ability, scholar level 3rd.

You gain Orator as a bonus feat. In addition, you can substitute a Linguistics skill check in place of any Perform (oratory) skill check, including when using the Orator feat.

True Linguist (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Cunning Linguist study ability, Intelligence 12, scholar level 5th.

By diligently studying so many languages, you begin to see through their complexities to understand the common threads that bind them all together. You learn to speak the First Language, and can use one 1st-level recitation from the Codex of Hearts and Minds, as a truenamer. You gain an additional 1st-level recitation from this codex when you reach 9 ranks in Linguistics.

When you reach 14 ranks in Linguistics, you learn one recitation from this codex of 2nd-level or lower. When you reach 19 ranks in Linguistics, you learn one recitation from this codex of 3rd-level or lower. You use 1/2 your ranks in Linguistics as your effective truenamer level for the purpose of making truenaming DC checks. The armor check penalty of any light armor you wear is halved, rounded down to a minimum of 0, for the purpose of determining truenaming DCs. You otherwise follow the standard rules for truemagic (see Strange Magic, page 193).
